verdict.rationale: The pack's only webhook evidence is Bridge's quick-start page, which documents that Bridge webhooks deliver real-time notifications for account events. This is a first-party, registrable outbound callback, but the pack has nothing on webhook events for Stripe's crypto and stablecoin payments, payouts or onramp, nor on endpoint registration, event types or signature verification. Missing for 10: documented crypto/stablecoin-specific event types on the Stripe side, details on endpoint registration and payload signing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Bridge webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your Bridge account.
